name: kong-screening
description: Test 4 (inline screening) on Kong OSS 3.9.3: the shared case set (../screening-cases.json) on both models, once each, Claude in native Vertex format (AGW_GATEWAY_CLAUDE_API=anthropic). Run it three times and say which in --note: A with the committed config (no screening: what the models do on their own), B with the ai-prompt-guard window (regex deny patterns on the user's messages; a match is Kong's 400 "bad request", classed blocked), and C with the ai-request-transformer window (an LLM rewrites each request body with personal data replaced by [REDACTED] before ai-proxy; mask_marker matches it). Windows: README.md, "Test 4". Kong's 400 for a request naming the wrong model would also class as blocked, so check B's errors read "bad request".
